```{r}
# Read all PNG filenames from w2560/
flag_files <- sort(list.files("w2560", pattern = "\\.png$"))

# Compute a combined RGB color + spatial design + shape feature vector for each flag
get_flag_features <- \(f) {
  img <- png::readPNG(file.path("w2560", f), native = TRUE)
  d <- dim(img)
  rows <- round(seq(1, d[1], length.out = 48))
  cols <- round(seq(1, d[2], length.out = 72))
  sub <- img[rows, cols]
  r <- bitwAnd(sub, 255L) / 255
  g <- bitwAnd(bitwShiftR(sub, 8L), 255L) / 255
  b <- bitwAnd(bitwShiftR(sub, 16L), 255L) / 255
  a <- bitwAnd(bitwShiftR(sub, 24L), 255L) / 255
  dim(r) <- dim(g) <- dim(b) <- dim(a) <- c(48, 72)

  # 1. Global 64-bin RGB color histogram (overall color palette)
  bins <- floor(r * 3.999) * 16L + floor(g * 3.999) * 4L + floor(b * 3.999) + 1L
  hist_feat <- tabulate(bins, nbins = 64L) / length(bins)

  # 2. Regional color layout across a 4x6 grid (canton, center emblem, bands)
  rg <- rep(1:4, each = 12)
  cg <- rep(1:6, each = 12)
  reg_mean <- \(m) as.vector(tapply(m, list(rg[row(m)], cg[col(m)]), mean))
  reg_rgb <- c(reg_mean(r), reg_mean(g), reg_mean(b)) / sqrt(72)

  # 3. Design & shape features: aspect ratio, non-rectangular shape, stripes, star/badge detail
  dy <- abs(r[-1, ] - r[-48, ]) + abs(g[-1, ] - g[-48, ]) + abs(b[-1, ] - b[-48, ])
  dx <- abs(r[, -1] - r[, -72]) + abs(g[, -1] - g[, -72]) + abs(b[, -1] - b[, -72])
  rg_e <- rep(1:4, length.out = 47)
  cg_e <- rep(1:6, length.out = 71)
  reg_dy <- pmin(as.vector(tapply(dy[, -72], list(rg_e[row(dy[, -72])], cg_e[col(dy[, -72])]), mean)), 0.5)
  reg_dx <- pmin(as.vector(tapply(dx[-48, ], list(rg_e[row(dx[-48, ])], cg_e[col(dx[-48, ])]), mean)), 0.5)
  stripe_dir <- c(mean(dy), mean(dx), sd(rowMeans(dy)), sd(colMeans(dx)))
  shape_feat <- c((d[2] / d[1]) / 2, 1 - mean(a))

  c(hist_feat * 1.2, reg_rgb * 1.4, reg_dy * 0.8, reg_dx * 0.8, stripe_dir * 0.8, shape_feat * 0.5)
}

feat_mat <- do.call(rbind, lapply(flag_files, get_flag_features))
dist_mat <- as.matrix(dist(feat_mat))
rownames(dist_mat) <- colnames(dist_mat) <- flag_files

# Center and L2-normalize features so the most different flag reflects true opposite color/shape/design
centered <- scale(feat_mat, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)
normed <- centered / sqrt(rowSums(centered^2))
opp_dist_mat <- as.matrix(dist(normed))
rownames(opp_dist_mat) <- colnames(opp_dist_mat) <- flag_files

# For each flag, find the 3 most similar flags and the 1 most different flag
similar_map <- setNames(
  lapply(flag_files, \(f) {
    others <- dist_mat[f, setdiff(flag_files, f)]
    names(sort(others)[1:3])
  }),
  flag_files
)

most_diff_map <- setNames(
  lapply(flag_files, \(f) {
    others <- opp_dist_mat[f, setdiff(flag_files, f)]
    names(which.max(others))
  }),
  flag_files
)

ojs_define(
  flag_files = flag_files,
  similar_map = similar_map,
  most_diff_map = most_diff_map
)
```

```{ojs}
// Convert 2-letter ISO codes (like "us") into readable names (like "United States")
regionNames = new Intl.DisplayNames(["en"], { type: "region" })

customNames = ({
  "gb-eng": "England",
  "gb-nir": "Northern Ireland",
  "gb-sct": "Scotland",
  "gb-wls": "Wales"
})

getName = (file) => {
  const code = file.replace(".png", "");
  return customNames[code] ?? regionNames.of(code.toUpperCase()) ?? code;
}

// Build a sorted list of { name, file } objects for the dropdown
flags = flag_files
  .map(file => ({ name: getName(file), file }))
  .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name))

// Dropdown menu for selecting a flag
viewof selected = Inputs.select(flags, {
  label: "🔍 Choose a country or territory:",
  format: d => d.name,
  value: flags.find(d => d.file === "us.png")
})

// Helper to jump to any flag when a card or the random button is clicked
selectFlag = (file) => {
  const target = flags.find(d => d.file === file);
  if (target) {
    viewof selected.value = target;
    viewof selected.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
  }
}

// Surprise Me button to pick a random flag
{
  const btn = html`<button class="random-btn" type="button">🎲 Surprise Me with a Random Flag!</button>`;
  btn.onclick = () => {
    const randomItem = flags[Math.floor(Math.random() * flags.length)];
    selectFlag(randomItem.file);
  };
  return html`<div style="text-align: center; margin-bottom: 1.5rem;">${btn}</div>`;
}

// Look up the 3 most similar flags and the 1 most different flag
similarFlags = similar_map[selected.file].map((file, idx) => ({
  file,
  name: getName(file),
  rank: idx + 1
}))

mostDiffFlag = ({
  file: most_diff_map[selected.file],
  name: getName(most_diff_map[selected.file])
})

// Display the interactive dashboard
{
  const container = html`<div>
    <div class="hero-card">
      <div class="hero-flag-wrap">
        <img src="w2560/${selected.file}" alt="${selected.name} flag">
      </div>
      <h2 style="margin: 1rem 0 0.2rem 0; font-weight: 800; color: #0f172a;">
        ${selected.name}
        <span class="badge-pill">${selected.file.replace(".png", "").toUpperCase()}</span>
      </h2>
    </div>

    <div class="section-heading">
      <h3>✨ 3 Flags with Similar Color &amp; Design</h3>
      <span class="hint-text">💡 Click any flag card to explore it!</span>
    </div>
    <div class="flag-grid">
      ${similarFlags.map(f => {
        const card = html`
          <div class="flag-card" title="Click to view ${f.name}">
            <span class="rank-tag rank-sim">Match #${f.rank}</span>
            <div class="flag-card-img-box">
              <img src="w2560/${f.file}" alt="${f.name} flag">
            </div>
            <div style="font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.02rem; color: #1e293b;">${f.name}</div>
            <div style="color: #64748b; font-size: 0.82rem;">${f.file}</div>
          </div>
        `;
        card.onclick = () => selectFlag(f.file);
        return card;
      })}
    </div>

    <div class="section-heading" style="margin-top: 2.5rem;">
      <h3>⚡ Most Different Flag in Color &amp; Shape</h3>
      <span class="hint-text">Opposite in palette, layout &amp; proportions</span>
    </div>
    <div style="max-width: 320px;">
      ${(() => {
        const oppCard = html`
          <div class="flag-card opposite-card" title="Click to view ${mostDiffFlag.name}">
            <span class="rank-tag rank-opp">Polar Opposite</span>
            <div class="flag-card-img-box">
              <img src="w2560/${mostDiffFlag.file}" alt="${mostDiffFlag.name} flag">
            </div>
            <div style="font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.02rem; color: #1e293b;">${mostDiffFlag.name}</div>
            <div style="color: #64748b; font-size: 0.82rem;">${mostDiffFlag.file}</div>
          </div>
        `;
        oppCard.onclick = () => selectFlag(mostDiffFlag.file);
        return oppCard;
      })()}
    </div>
  </div>`;
  return container;
}
```
